description:
At River we are building the world's most trusted financial institution to empower people to take ownership of their financial lives through Bitcoin, the world's only incorruptible digital money. We believe in a future where every person will have bitcoin savings, and every business will have bitcoin on the balance sheet. We obsessively design and build delightful products that help our clients buy, sell, secure, and use Bitcoin.

Our team depends on secure, reliable tools to serve clients every day. We're looking for a Senior IT Systems Engineer to automate River's corporate systems end to end: identity, devices, and the software our team uses. You'll bring an engineering mindset and systems thinking to IT, using AI agents and software to eliminate anything that slows down our corporate systems, and you'll have the influence to shape how IT works at River.

You'll partner closely with engineering, security, and operations, and help every teammate do their best work securely.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Automate away manual IT work, from provisioning to access reviews to support requests

  • Own automating identity and access provisioning across corporate systems: single sign-on, provisioning, MFA, onboarding, and offboarding

  • Build AI agents to facilitate self-serve IT across the company

  • Manage and harden our laptop and mobile device fleet as code, with as little hands-on work as possible

  • Work with IT operations to administer and secure the business tools our team relies on

  • Keep access least-privilege by default, and automate access reviews that are fast and accurate

  • Evaluate new tools and vendors before we adopt them, with a focus on security and data handling

  • Maintain technical controls and deliver evidence for our compliance audits

  • Partner with our security engineers on endpoint security and incident response

  • Help teammates quickly and thoughtfully, and fix root causes so problems don't come back

  • Keep corporate systems resilient and ready for business continuity events

What We Look For In You

  • 6+ years in IT, systems engineering, or corporate engineering, ideally at a fast-growing technology or financial company

  • Deep experience administering an identity provider, device management, and a SaaS-heavy environment for a remote team

  • You automate by default: comfortable with scripting (Python, Bash, or similar) and APIs, and familiar with infrastructure as code

  • Strong security fundamentals: phishing-resistant MFA, least privilege, and endpoint hardening

  • Experience supporting security audits with clean, automated evidence

  • You use AI agents to automate your own work, and understand their security risks

  • You take ownership, fix problems at the root, and see projects through

  • Clear written communication and a service mindset

Nice To Haves

  • Experience at a bank, exchange, or other regulated financial institution

  • Managing MacOS device fleets

  • Small-office networking

  • Interest in Bitcoin

Location & Salary

  • 100% remote option available within the USA, with offices in NYC and Columbus

  • Salary range between $150,000 - $220,000 based on skills and experience

  • Significant equity stock options

  • Medical, Dental and Vision Benefits

  • Unlimited PTO

  • Parental Leave separate from regular PTO policy

  • 401k

This role requires a background check.
